description: Rename a function across a package while keeping a deprecated alias.

contract.objective: Rename the function calc_total to compute_total throughout the shop package and update every call site. Export compute_total from the shop package. Keep calc_total importable from shop.cart and from shop as a deprecated alias: calling it must emit a DeprecationWarning and return the same result as compute_total. Code inside the package must not call the deprecated alias.
acceptance_criteria: compute_total is defined in shop/cart.py and exported by shop
calc_total remains as a warning alias
No call site inside the package uses calc_total
